name: Lark / Feishu
description: Indexes Lark/Feishu cloud documents and chat history through a locally authenticated lark-cli.

fields.title: Index chat history
fields.description: Index messages from group chats and direct messages. Uncheck to index cloud documents only.

fields.title: Chat history lookback (days)
fields.description: How many days of chat history to backfill on the first sync. Later syncs are incremental.

fields.title: lark-cli path
fields.description: Path to the lark-cli executable. Keep the default if lark-cli is on PATH.
